lead_raw_text:
The structure of K4Mg2Sb4O12 (K2Mg(SbO3)2) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 22 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Mg centers coordinated by six O neighbors, while Sb centers adopt a trigonal bipyramidal environment of five O atoms and K centers exhibit a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 geometric neighbors (K, Mg, Sb, and O). O centers have two or three geometric neighbors, one Sb and the others a mix of K, Mg, and Sb. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between K and Sb polyhedra and corner- and edge-sharing between Sb trigonal bipyramids, forming a three-dimensional connected network.
